result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers trace the problem to a lack of hierarchy and consistency and tie it closely to the 28/26/24px bold lines and the four button styles. A prioritizes better: it puts the Get tickets button and the type scale first, and it has an explicit 'Keep these' section on what already works. B ranks photo sizes as the top fix and says almost nothing about what is already fine. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers identify the lack of hierarchy as the root cause and tie it to the 28/26/24px bold lines and the four button styles. B explains the visitor impact more clearly: the date ties with the title, and the ticket button looks the weakest of the four. B also ranks each problem and puts buttons and the type scale first, which fits the rubric better than A putting photo sizes first. B has a dedicated 'Keep these' section, while A only notes in passing that centered text is fine for a headline.
